objective: Persist a pending scheduled irrigation event in the existing committed physical state and advance it only with accepted hydraulic progress, including fresh-owner mid-event restart.
design_constraints: Register a distinct optional-state layout without altering BASE. Combine event continuation with the existing Richards temporal history rather than replacing either. Preserve exact-type dispatch and clone behavior explicitly at every state match. No separate application-owned authoritative event ledger. No unconditional publication after batch return: acceptance is per tile, as demonstrated by the mixed zero-source control.
event_contract: Selected rate, start/end and origin belong to the physical candidate. Parameter/crop/profile inputs remain supplied configuration. Rejected attempts cannot advance the pending event; final accepted boundary clears it exactly once. Interval splitting respects event end. Restart validates layout, parameter identity, event validity and boundary time before publication.
gates: Existing BASE/temporal-profile preservation; disabled option unchanged; selection rejection and split/retry; one failed tile alongside one successful tile; partial internal progress rollback; accepted event advance; fresh-owner restart mid-event and at exact event end; resumed/uninterrupted physical state and mass identity; no duplicate irrigation after completion. Run O0/O2 with unchanged mass and temporal acceptance limits.
scope: First restricted candidate: supplied typed DCS1/DCS2 and single-node SSDI in standalone mode 7 using the established explicit numerical profile. Parser/calendar, surface delivery, solute transport and other optional-state combinations remain separate.
first_implementation_step: Add the registered optional-state carrier and clone/restart matching tests before enabling runtime selection. Then implement accepted trial publication and source mapping together; never claim the carrier alone provides production irrigation.
